title: I finished my first game!
author: PipeDazzling
selftext:
Its silly, but I'm really proud of it! 

I came from a creative environment (a musician, artist, etc)

But because of my dyscalculia, I was unable to learn coding. I felt that I would never be able to bring my game ideas to life. 

This game is a tongue in cheek parody, but the idea was to learn actual skills I could use in my next game. 

Essentially everything in the game is AI, but the directing, humor, gameplay mechanics etc are all mine. 

I also built a rather involved testing harness and regressions matrix the ai has to follow to make sure nothing breaks. 

I hope you guys will check it out and give me feedback. ☺️
